comparison.objective: Replace a faulty UPS cartridge while maintaining server power via maintenance bypass.
comparison.physical_skill: Switch sequencing, isolation, cartridge exchange, readiness waiting, and restoration.
comparison.success_condition: No sampled outage and no removal before isolation; cartridge replaced and normal supply restored.
comparison.reason: Tests safety-critical electrical-state sequencing and modular exchange rather than controlled mechanical fracture and fragment recovery. Cartridge seating tolerances are not specified.
